chapter.heading: Israel Needs the Gospel
chapter.v:
Brethren, my
heart’s desire and prayer to God for Israel is that they may be saved. [Rom. 14:1;]

For I
bear them witness that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge. [1 Cor. 9:22;]

For they
being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted to the righteousness of God. [Matt. 26:39; [Phil. 2:5-8]] [Ps. 69:9 # 4 e Rom. 4:23, 24;]

For Christ
is the end of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.

For Moses
writes about the righteousness which is of the law, “The man who does those things shall live by them.”

But the
righteousness of faith speaks in this way, “Do not say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ ” (that is, to bring Christ down from above)

or, “
‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ ” (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead).

But what
does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart” (that is, the word of faith which we preach):

that if
you confess with your mouth the Lord Jesus and believe in your heart that God has raised Him from the dead, you will be saved. [John 10:16]

For with
the heart one believes unto righteousness, and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation. [Deut. 32:43]

For the
Scripture says, “Whoever believes on Him will not be put to shame.” [Ps. 117:1]

For there
is no distinction between Jew and Greek, for the same Lord over all is rich to all who call upon Him. [Is. 11:1, 10 #]

For “whoever
calls on the name of the Lord shall be saved.”Israel Rejects the Gospel [Rom. 12:12;]

How then
shall they call on Him in whom they have not believed? And how shall they believe in Him of whom they have not heard? And how shall they hear without a preacher? [2 Pet. 1:12]

And how
shall they preach unless they are sent? As it is written:“How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the gospel of peace,Who bring glad tidings of good things!” [Rom. 1:5; 12:3]

But they
have not all obeyed the gospel. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?” [Acts 9:15;]

So then
faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God. [Heb. 2:17; 5:1]

But I
say, have they not heard? Yes indeed:“Their sound has gone out to all the earth,And their words to the ends of the world.” [Acts 15:12;]

But I
say, did Israel not know? First Moses says:“I will provoke you to jealousy by those who are not a nation,I will move you to anger by a foolish nation.” [Acts 19:11]

But Isaiah
is very bold and says:“I was found by those who did not seek Me;I was made manifest to those who did not ask for Me.” [1 Cor. 3:10;]

But to
Israel he says:“All day long I have stretched out My handsTo a disobedient and contrary people.” [Is. 52:15]
